title: Windows Laptops That Rival the MacBook Air (2026)
summary: The Dell XPS 14, Microsoft Surface Laptop 7 and HP OmniBook Ultra are the Windows laptops reviewers most often name as MacBook Air rivals.
method: Picks come from Digital Trends, Tom's Guide (as cited by CloudColleague), Tbreak, GeekChamp, CNET (as cited by iTechGuides) and Parse's roundup of AI answers. Only models named by at least two of these sources are listed.
assumptions: We show no prices because laptop prices rose and changed often in 2026. Check the current price and configuration before you buy.

products.name: Dell XPS 14 (2026)
why: Tom's Guide rates the XPS 14 its best overall Windows laptop, according to CloudColleague, with battery life above 20 hours in testing and a chassis of about three pounds. Tbreak describes it as Windows at its most Mac-like.
Tbreak lists a unibody aluminium chassis, an Intel Core Ultra 7 355 chip and a 120Hz display. Parse's roundup also names the Dell XPS as the top Windows alternative.
pros: Excellent battery life in Tom's Guide testing
products.best_for: People who want Windows with MacBook-level polish
products.skip_if: You want to spend less or need a tablet-style 2-in-1
products.amazon_listing: Dell XPS 14 Premium Laptop DA14250-14.5-inch Touch 3.2K OLED 48-120Hz Display, Intel Core
products.desc: A Windows laptop with a unibody aluminium chassis, an Intel Core Ultra 7 355 chip and a 120Hz variable-refresh display. It is not a tablet-style 2-in-1.
products.benefit: Picture a student or professional who wants a laptop that looks and feels like a MacBook but runs Windows. Tom's Guide reports battery life above 20 hours in testing, as cited by CloudColleague, in a chassis of about three pounds, and Tbreak rates the keyboard among the best. It is the only pick in this guide with a tested battery figure above 20 hours. The catch: it is premium-priced.

products.name: Microsoft Surface Laptop (7th Edition)
why: Digital Trends names the Surface Laptop 7, a Snapdragon X Elite machine, as the alternative to the 15-inch MacBook Air, calling the 15-inch model fast and long-lasting. GeekChamp picks it as the best Windows-first alternative to the MacBook Air.
GeekChamp says it suits people whose school or work depends on Windows-native software.
pros: Efficient battery use that challenges the MacBook Air (Digital Trends)
cons: Windows on Arm may not run every app
products.best_for: Windows users who want a clean, Air-like laptop
products.skip_if: You rely on software that isn't ready for Windows on Arm
products.amazon_listing: 2024 Microsoft Surface Laptop 7th Edition, Copilot+ PC, 15in Snapdragon X-Elite 16GB RAM 5
products.desc: A Windows laptop with a Qualcomm Snapdragon X Elite chip. It is a Copilot+ PC that runs Windows on Arm, with a 15-inch version available.
products.benefit: Picture a student whose school software is Windows-native and who still wants an Air-like laptop. Digital Trends calls the 15-inch model fast and long-lasting, and its efficient battery use challenges the MacBook Air. GeekChamp picks it as the best Windows-first alternative. It is the only pick here that runs Windows on Arm. The catch: Windows on Arm may not run every app.

products.name: HP OmniBook Ultra 14
why: A University of Georgia ag-tech guide calls the HP OmniBook Ultra 14 the strongest alternative to the MacBook Air for people who prefer Windows or need it for specific apps.
Tbreak names the OmniBook Ultra Flip 14 with a Core Ultra 7 256V its best Windows Air alternative, as a 2-in-1 OLED.
pros: Strong premium alternative to the Air
Flip version adds tablet mode and OLED
products.best_for: Windows users who want the closest thing to an Air
products.amazon_listing: HP OmniBook X 14 inch Next Gen AI PC, 3K Touchscreen, Intel® CORE™ Ultra 7 Processor 356H,
products.desc: A 14-inch Windows laptop. Tbreak's pick is the Flip version, a 2-in-1 OLED with an Intel Core Ultra 7 256V. The standard version is not a 2-in-1.
products.benefit: Picture a Windows user who wants the closest thing to an Air, for specific apps that need Windows. A University of Georgia ag-tech guide calls it the strongest alternative to the MacBook Air for people who prefer Windows or need it for specific apps, and the Flip version adds tablet mode and OLED. The catch: it is premium-priced.

products.name: Lenovo Yoga 9i 2-in-1 (Aura Edition)
why: CNET, as cited by iTechGuides, names the Yoga 9i 2-in-1 Aura Edition its best convertible. Parse's roundup lists it as a top Windows alternative to the MacBook Air.
It adds a flip-and-fold design that the MacBook Air doesn't offer.
pros: Named by more than one source as an Air alternative
cons: Convertible design may cost more than a plain laptop
products.best_for: People who want touch and pen use plus a laptop
products.skip_if: You only want a simple, light clamshell
products.amazon_listing: Lenovo Yoga 9i 2-in-1 Aura Edition with 14” OLED 4K Touchscreen, 32GB RAM | Intel Ultra 7
products.desc: A 2-in-1 convertible in the Aura Edition. It folds and flips, which the MacBook Air does not.
products.benefit: Picture a user who takes handwritten notes with a pen in tablet mode, then flips the screen back to type. CNET, as cited by iTechGuides, names it its best convertible, and Parse's roundup lists it as a top Windows alternative to the MacBook Air. It adds a flip-and-fold design that the MacBook Air does not offer. The catch: the convertible design may cost more than a plain laptop.

intro: A Windows laptop can now match the MacBook Air on the things people buy an Air for. The Dell XPS 14 lasted above 20 hours in Tom's Guide testing, as cited by CloudColleague, in a chassis of about three pounds.
One of the four picks runs Windows on Arm, so check that your apps run on it before you buy.

verdict.line: If you want Windows with MacBook-level polish, get this one: Tom's Guide rates it its best overall Windows laptop, according to CloudColleague, and Tbreak calls it Windows at its most Mac-like. It is premium-priced.

tips.title: 4 mistakes when shopping for a MacBook Air alternative
items: The Surface Laptop 7 uses a Snapdragon X Elite chip, and Windows on Arm may not run every app.
Buying a convertible when you want a plain laptop.
The Yoga 9i adds a flip-and-fold design the MacBook Air does not offer. If you want a simple, light clamshell, skip it.
Tbreak's pick is the OmniBook Ultra Flip 14, a 2-in-1 OLED with a Core Ultra 7 256V. The plain OmniBook Ultra 14 is a different model.
Trusting battery claims you cannot compare.
Only the XPS 14 has a tested figure above 20 hours here. Digital Trends calls the 15-inch Surface Laptop 7 long-lasting, but gives no hours in these sources.

faq: What is the best Windows alternative to the MacBook Air?
The Dell XPS 14 (2026). Tom's Guide rates it its best overall Windows laptop, according to CloudColleague, and Parse's roundup also names it the top Windows alternative.
Which alternative has the best battery life?
The Dell XPS 14. Tom's Guide reports battery life above 20 hours in testing, as cited by CloudColleague.
Which is best if I depend on Windows software?
The Surface Laptop 7 is GeekChamp's best Windows-first alternative, but Windows on Arm may not run every app.
Is there a 2-in-1 alternative to the MacBook Air?
Yes. CNET, as cited by iTechGuides, names the Yoga 9i 2-in-1 Aura Edition its best convertible. Tbreak picks the OmniBook Ultra Flip 14.
